title: emcli ModelChangeStream SSE event
description: Schema for the JSON carried in the `data:` field of each Server-Sent Event on GET /stream. The stream opens with a Snapshot; every following event is a Delta, except that an import re-snapshots every connected client instead of emitting a delta (and a reconnect opens a fresh stream with its own snapshot). The SSE `event:` line equals the payload's `op` field ("snapshot" for a snapshot, the rule name for deltas). GET /snapshot returns a bare SnapshotEvent (same payload, no SSE framing).

SnapshotEvent.description: The full canonical model, sent once when a client connects (SnapshotThenDeltas). Every entity carries its integer `id` (the same surrogate identity the deltas use), so a consumer can seed a normalised store from the snapshot and patch it by id from later deltas. Denormalised display fields (element/connection names) are nested under their sub-entity, which also carries its id; the model's elements are additionally listed flat under `elements`, each in the canonical record shape a delta uses, so that an element no placement or connection reaches is still seeded.

elements.description: Every element of the model, each carrying the full canonical element record — the same shape a delta's element `entity` uses, derived `is_information_complete` included — in creation order. Conditional fields (`swimlane`, `image_url`, `wireframe`) are absent until the operation that sets them, and are explicitly null once set and then cleared (swimlane after the swimlane it pointed at is deleted, wireframe after a screen's root node is deleted) — exactly as on a delta entity, which is what these entries are. This is the model's single-source element registry: an element that is placed nowhere and wired to nothing appears in full only here (it may still be named by a specification step's `{id, name}` ref). A consumer seeds its element index from this list, so that a later placement or connection delta, which references an element by id alone, resolves for an element that existed when the snapshot was taken.

is_complete.description: The slice's pattern composition: one command (state_change), one read model (state_view), or one command and one automation (automation). Independent of `status`: an informational slice still reports it.

swimlane.description: Swimlane id, or null if unassigned.

is_information_complete.description: True iff every field on the element is sourced (carried, derived or introduced).

image_url.description: Reference image URL for screen elements; null until SetImageUrl is invoked.

wireframe.description: Hiccup-like wireframe tree; null until AddWireframeNode is invoked on a screen element.

fields.description: Shape only (subfields are not streamed here); see SnapshotField.

specifications.description: The slice's specifications, in creation order.

index.description: author-controlled display order within the model

derivations.description: Connection-local field provenance: how named target fields are derived from source fields.

SnapshotSpecification.description: A specification as projected on a snapshot slice.

is_complete.description: One when_step naming a command (state_change/automation slice), or one then_step naming a read model (state_view slice).

SnapshotStep.description: A given/when/then step as projected on a snapshot specification.

error_name.description: the error outcome this step asserts; null unless is_error

element.description: the element this step asserts about; null on an error step

examples.description: concrete example values for the referenced element's fields

DeltaEvent.description: One delta per committed authoring mutation (DeltaPerMutation), delivered in commit order. Carries id-keyed, normalised canonical entities with integer foreign-key references. A cascading delete is a single delta whose `changes` lists every removed entity.

oneOf.description: An entity was created or updated; `entity` is its full new canonical state.
An entity was removed. No `entity` payload is sent for deletions.

Entity.description: A canonical store entity. The variant is discriminated by `type`. All entities carry an integer `id` and `type`; relationships are integer foreign-key ids.

index.description: author-controlled display order within the model

swimlane.description: assigned Swimlane id; absent until AssignSwimlane is invoked

image_url.description: wireframe URL for screen elements; absent until SetImageUrl is invoked

field_origins.description: operator overrides marking fields that are legitimately introduced here

is_information_complete.description: True iff every field on the element is sourced (carried, derived or introduced). Always present on an element change, whether created or updated: the verdict is derived from the store, not carried in the stored entity.

wireframe.description: hiccup-like layout tree; absent until a screen's first node is added, and null again once its root node is deleted

element.description: Element this step asserts about; absent on an error step (is_error=true)

Field.description: An element field as stored, in the canonical shape: `optional` is false, `cardinality` is single and `subfields` is [] unless the author set otherwise, so every route that authors a field (a CLI flag set, a pre-built argument map, an interchange import) produces the same record.

SnapshotField.description: A field as streamed on a snapshot placement's element: shape only, no subfields. The full recursive Field shape (subfields included) travels in the element's canonical record instead — a delta `entity`, or the matching `model.elements` entry. `optional` and `cardinality` are always carried, defaulted to false and single when the author did not set them.

FieldDerivation.description: Connection-local provenance: a target field derived from one or more source fields (one with a different name = rename; many = aggregation).

source_fields.description: field(s) on the `from` element it derives from

FieldOrigin.description: Override declaring a field is legitimately introduced rather than sourced upstream.

WireframeNode.description: A layout node in hiccup-like form: [tag, id-map, attrs?, ...children]. Cheshire serialises Clojure keywords as strings, so the Clojure vector `[:button {:-id "n2"} {:label "OK" :variant :primary}]` arrives on the wire as `["button", {"-id": "n2"}, {"label": "OK", "variant": "primary"}]`. The first element is the tag; the second always carries "-id", a stable string address for incremental edits, allocated one past the highest id in the tree, so deleting a node neither shifts nor changes any other node's id (only the highest-numbered node's own number is freed for reuse). A third object, when the node has content attributes, holds those attributes in a map of its own — the id map stays separate — and the children follow it. The tree's root node is always tagged "canvas" (the tree IS the wireframe; there is no wrapper object), and no other node is one. The tag and attribute vocabulary is in doc/wireframe-dsl.md.

prefixItems.description: the node's id map; always contains "-id" and nothing else

-id.description: stable node address for incremental edits

oneOf.description: text child (only on text-children tags: h1, h2, h3, text, span)

WireframeAttributes.description: A layout node's content attributes, valid per its tag (see doc/wireframe-dsl.md). Keyword values arrive as their names, booleans as booleans, and a list-valued attribute such as a dropdown's options as an array of strings.

deltaOp.description: The authoring operation that produced the delta (also the SSE event name): every operation of the ModelAuthoring surface that mutates the model appears here, and nothing else produces a delta (import re-snapshots instead). A composite operation - one the surface offers as a single verb but which edits one entry of a whole-list field, such as AddField or AddDerivation - reports the delta of the whole-list operation it decomposes into (SetFields, SetFieldOrigins, SetConnectionDerivations, SetStepExamples), so those four names each cover several verbs.
